definition: A person who tends to expect favourable or positive outcomes in life.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo har mushkil situation mein positive pehlu dekhta hai aur acche parinaam ki umeed rakhta hai.
example: Even after facing consecutive setbacks, the optimist believed the verdict would be in their favour.
keyDistinction: Optimist positive outcome expect karta hai, jabki pessimist negative outcome ki umeed karta hai.

definition: A person who habitually expects the worst or sees the negative side of things.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo har sthiti mein negative pehlu dekhta hai aur bura hone ki umeed karta hai.
example: The pessimist predicted that the system implementation would fail despite thorough testing.
keyDistinction: Pessimist hamesha worst-case scenario anticipate karta hai, chahe evidence kuch bhi ho.

definition: A person who is predominantly concerned with their own internal thoughts and feelings rather than external social interaction.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo zyada bolne ke bajaye apne vicharon mein rehta hai aur akelepan ya shant mahaul mein energy mehsus karta hai.
example: Being an introvert, the research analyst preferred quiet drafting to public deliberations.
keyDistinction: Introvert inward-focused aur reserved hota hai; extrovert social engagement se energize hota hai.

definition: An outgoing, socially active person who gains energy from interaction with other people.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo milansar, khulam-khula aur logon ke beech rehkar khush rehta hai.
example: His extrovert nature made him a natural public relations officer for the department.
keyDistinction: Extrovert outward-focused hota hai aur social environments ko actively seek karta hai.

definition: A person who dislikes, distrusts, or avoids humankind in general.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo poori manav jati se nafrat karta hai ya unpar vishwas nahi karta.
example: Bitter after years of deceit, the old clerk retired as a recluse and a confirmed misanthrope.
keyDistinction: Misanthrope humanity se nafrat karta hai (mis- = hate, anthropos = human); philanthropist humanity ki bhalai chahta hai.

definition: A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo manav jati ke kalyan ke liye apna dhan aur resources daan karta hai.
example: The industrialist lived simply but was known across Rajasthan as a generous philanthropist.
keyDistinction: Philanthropist aamtaur par structured charitable donations karta hai; altruist kisi bhi tarah doosron ki selfless madad karta hai.

definition: A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo mahilaon ke prati nafrat, durbhavna ya bhedbhav rakhta hai.
example: The court condemned the defendant's misogynist remarks as unbecoming of an officer.
keyDistinction: Misogynist mahilaon se nafrat karta hai (gyne = woman); misandrist purushon se nafrat karta hai (aner/andro = man).

definition: A person who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against men.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo purushon ke prati nafrat ya durbhavna rakhta hai.
example: Her extreme distrust of every male colleague led some to describe her as a misandrist.
keyDistinction: Misandrist men ke against hatred rakhta hai; misogynist women ke against.

definition: A person who shows selfless concern for the well-being of others without expecting personal gain.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo bina kisi swarth ke doosron ki bhalai aur seva ke liye samarpit rehta hai.
example: The dedicated relief worker was a true altruist who sacrificed his comforts for flood victims.
keyDistinction: Altruist selfless hota hai (doosron ke liye jeeta hai); egoist selfish hota hai (sirf apne faayde ke liye sochna).

definition: A person who is excessively conceited, self-absorbed, and constantly talks about themselves.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa ghamandi vyakti jo hamesha apni hi badhai aur uplabdhiyon ka bakhana karta rehta hai.
example: Nobody enjoyed conversation with the egotist because every topic ended with his personal praise.
keyDistinction: Egotist mein 'T' hota hai for 'Talk' (apne baare mein dhingein haankne wala); egoist self-interest ko prioritise karta hai chahe bole ya na bole.

definition: A person who is self-centred, selfish, and believes that self-interest is the actual motive of all conscious action.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo sirf apne hit aur faayde ke baare mein sochta hai; a self-centered person.
example: An egoist cares little about team welfare as long as his own promotion is secure.
keyDistinction: Egoist = selfish person (apne interest ka dhyan rakhne wala); Egotist = boastful talker (apni tareef karne wala).

definition: Well-meaning, kindly, and motivated by a desire to do good to others.
hinglishExplanation: Dayalu, kripalu, aur doosron ka bhala chahne wala vyakti ya aacharan.
example: The judge was known for his benevolent disposition toward first-time juvenile offenders.
keyDistinction: Benevolent = wishing well (bene = good); malevolent = wishing harm (mal = bad).

definition: Having or showing a wish to do evil or cause harm to others.
hinglishExplanation: Dushit bhavna wala, jo doosron ko nuksan pahunchane ya bura karne ki ichha rakhta ho.
example: The forged document was created with malevolent intent to ruin the officer's reputation.
keyDistinction: Malevolent burai aur hani chahne wala hota hai; benevolent kalyankari hota hai.

definition: Having or showing too great a readiness to believe things; easily deceived.
hinglishExplanation: Bohot jaldi vishwas kar lene wala; bholabhala vyakti jise asani se bevkuf banaya ja sake.
example: The fraudulent scheme targeted credulous villagers who trusted the fake official stamps.
keyDistinction: Credulous vyakti hota hai jo aasani se vishwas kar leta hai; credible wo cheez ya baat hoti hai jo vishwas karne yogya ho (believable).

definition: A person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions, claims, or evidence.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo kisi baat ko bina thos saboot ke asani se sach nahi maanta aur sandeh vyakt karta hai.
example: As an experienced forensic auditor, he was a natural skeptic who checked every voucher twice.
keyDistinction: Skeptic saboot aur verification maangta hai; cynic logon ke motives ko hamesha swarthi maanta hai.

definition: Fond of company, highly sociable, or living in flocks/communities.
hinglishExplanation: Milansar, samajik, aur logon ke jhund ya sangati mein rehna pasand karne wala.
example: His gregarious personality ensured that the departmental event was lively and well-coordinated.
keyDistinction: Gregarious sociable aur company-loving hota hai; taciturn shant aur kam bolne wala hota hai.

definition: Habitually reserved, quiet, or uncommunicative in speech; saying very little.
hinglishExplanation: Aadatan kam bolne wala, shant aur sankochpurna vyakti.
example: The senior clerk was notoriously taciturn, replying to queries in only one or two words.
keyDistinction: Taciturn aadat se bohot kam bolta hai; loquacious bohot zyada baatuni hota hai.

definition: Tending to talk a great deal; extremely talkative.
hinglishExplanation: Bohot zyada baatein karne wala; baatuni vyakti.
example: The loquacious advocate extended his oral submissions far beyond the allotted court time.
keyDistinction: Loquacious sirf bohot zyada bolta hai (quantity of talk); eloquent prabhavshali aur sundar dhang se bolta hai (quality of talk).

definition: Having or showing care and conscientious, persistent effort in one's work or duties.
hinglishExplanation: Mehanti, parishrami aur apne karya ke prati nishthavan vyakti.
example: Thanks to a diligent investigation by the inquiry officer, the entire record tampering was unmasked.
keyDistinction: Diligent persistent effort aur mehnat karta hai; indolent kaamchor aur aalsi hota hai.

definition: Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; habitually lazy.
hinglishExplanation: Aalsi, sust, aur mehnat se bachne wala vyakti.
example: The indolent apprentice neglected his daily case diary and missed the filing deadline.
keyDistinction: Indolent aalsi hota hai; diligent lagansheel aur parishrami hota hai.

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful, thorough, and precise.
hinglishExplanation: Chhoti-chhoti baaton aur details ka bohot dhyan rakhne wala; atyant savdhan aur barik.
example: The registrar did meticulous checking of all page numbers before certifying the record.
keyDistinction: Meticulous accuracy aur detail par focus karta hai; fastidious itna choosy hota hai ki use santusht karna mushkil ho.

definition: Treating all rivals or disputants equally; fair and just; unbiased.
hinglishExplanation: Nishpaksh, jo kisi ek paksh ka anuchit sath na de aur nyayapurna ho.
example: An impartial referee is essential to uphold the integrity of the judicial process.
keyDistinction: Impartial bina kisi pakshpaat ke nyay karta hai; partial/biased kisi ek side ko favour karta hai.

definition: Not showing care for the consequences of an action; rash, unwise, or indiscreet.
hinglishExplanation: Avivekpurna, laparwah, bina aage ka soche liya gaya nirnay ya vyavhar.
example: It was an imprudent decision to reveal confidential court documents before the official release.
keyDistinction: Imprudent laaparwah aur beparwah hota hai; prudent samajhdar aur doorandesh hota hai.

definition: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.
hinglishExplanation: Bahumukhi pratibha wala, jo kai alag-alag kaamo ko nipunata se kar sake.
example: As a versatile assistant, she could draft legal orders, troubleshoot network servers, and manage case files.
keyDistinction: Versatile multiple skills aur roles mein adaptable hota hai; specialist sirf ek field ka expert hota hai.

definition: Accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age, wisdom, or character.
hinglishExplanation: Aadarniya, sammaniya, jo apni umar, gyan ya pavitrata ki wajah se samman ke yogya ho.
example: The venerable retired chief justice was invited to inaugurate the state judicial academy.
keyDistinction: Venerable sammaniya hota hai (respectable); vulnerable kamzor ya aakraman ke prati asurakshit hota hai.

definition: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks, or showing a lack of respect; daring.
hinglishExplanation: Dussahasi, himmati, ya behad bebaak jo kabhi-kabhi aam maryada ko tod de.
example: The thief made an audacious attempt to snatch files right inside the court premises.
keyDistinction: Audacious bold aur risk-taking hota hai; timid darpok aur sankochi hota hai.

definition: Having or showing keen mental discernment and good judgment; wise.
hinglishExplanation: Buddhimaan, doorandesh aur achi samajh-bujh rakhne wala.
example: The sagacious advice of the senior advocate helped resolve the family partition amicably.
keyDistinction: Sagacious wise aur discerning hota hai; loquacious baatuni hota hai.

definition: Knowing everything; having complete or infinite knowledge.
hinglishExplanation: Sarvajna, jo sab kuch jaanta ho.
example: The narrator in the novel adopted an omniscient perspective, revealing every character's hidden thoughts.
keyDistinction: Omniscient = all-knowing (scient = know); omnipotent = all-powerful (potent = power); omnipresent = present everywhere.

definition: Having unlimited or very great power; all-powerful.
hinglishExplanation: Sarvashaktimaan, jiske paas asim shakti ho.
example: In ancient mythology, the king of gods was considered omnipotent and unchallenged.
keyDistinction: Omnipotent shakti (power) se related hai; omnipresent sthiti (presence) se related hai.

definition: Widely or constantly encountered; present everywhere at the same time.
hinglishExplanation: Sarvavyapi, jo har jagah ek hi samay mein upasthit ho.
example: With modern smartphone networks, digital surveillance has become virtually omnipresent.
keyDistinction: Omnipresent sab jagah maujood hona hai; omniscient sab kuch jaanna hai.

definition: A person who does not believe in the existence of God or gods.
hinglishExplanation: Nastik vyakti jo kisi bhi Ishwar ya bhagwan ke astitva mein vishwas nahi karta.
example: As a lifelong atheist, he requested a completely secular memorial service without religious rituals.
keyDistinction: Atheist Ishwar ke astitva ko reject karta hai; agnostic kehta hai ki Ishwar ke astitva ka gyan sambhav ya nishchit nahi hai.

definition: A person who believes in the existence of a god or gods, specifically a creator who intervenes in the universe.
hinglishExplanation: Astik vyakti jo Ishwar ya devtaon ke astitva mein vishwas rakhta hai.
example: A devout theist, he began every legal drafting session with a silent prayer.
keyDistinction: Theist vishwas karta hai (theos = god); atheist (a-theist) vishwas nahi karta.

definition: A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God.
hinglishExplanation: Aisa vyakti jo maanta hai ki Ishwar ka astitva anjaan ya a-gyeya hai; jo na toh poori tarah manta hai na nakarta hai.
example: He described himself as an agnostic, claiming human intellect cannot prove or disprove the divine.
keyDistinction: Agnostic knowledge claim karta hai (gnosis = knowledge: 'hum jaan nahi sakte'); atheist belief reject karta hai.

definition: A person who knows and is able to use several languages.
hinglishExplanation: Bahu-bhashavid; aisa vyakti jo kai alag-alag bhashayein bol aur samajh sakta hai.
example: The high court interpreter was a polyglot who could translate Hindi, Rajasthani, Urdu, and English fluently.
keyDistinction: Polyglot kai bhashayein bolta/use karta hai; linguist bhasha ka scientific aur structural adhyayan karta hai.

definition: A person skilled in foreign languages or a person who studies language scientifically.
hinglishExplanation: Bhasha-shastri; aisa vidwan jo bhasha ke niyam, structure aur itihaas ka vaigyanik adhyayan karta hai.
example: The linguist analyzed the dialect variations across western Rajasthan to identify phonetic shifts.
keyDistinction: Linguist language science ka scholar hota hai; polyglot kai bhashayein bolne wala hota hai.

definition: A person who collects or has a great love of books.
hinglishExplanation: Pustak-premi; aisa vyakti jise kitabein padhne aur ikattha karne ka bohot shauk ho.
example: His chamber looked like a public archive because he was an incurable bibliophile.
keyDistinction: Bibliophile kitabon se pyar karta hai (biblio = book, phile = love); philologist bhasha aur historical texts ka scholar hota hai.

definition: A person who compiles, edits, or writes dictionaries.
hinglishExplanation: Shabdakoshkar; aisa vyakti jo dictionary (shabdakosh) likhta ya compile karta hai.
example: Samuel Johnson is remembered in English literary history as a pioneering lexicographer.
keyDistinction: Lexicographer dictionary banata hai; philologist bhasha ki historical development study karta hai.

definition: A public speaker, especially one who is eloquent or skilled.
hinglishExplanation: Kushal vakta; aisa vyakti jo janta ke samne prabhavshali aur aakarshak bhashan deta hai.
example: The senior bar member was a gifted orator who could persuade the jury with majestic clarity.
keyDistinction: Orator formal speech dene mein skilled hota hai; debater arguments counter karne mein focused hota hai.

definition: A person new to and inexperienced in a job, situation, or field; a beginner.
hinglishExplanation: Naukhiya, anari, ya kisi kshetra mein naya vyakti jise anubhav na ho.
example: Even a novice clerk could identify the glaring clerical error in the case number.
keyDistinction: Novice beginner hota hai; veteran purana aur anubhavi hota hai.

definition: A person who has had long service or experience in a particular occupation, activity, or military force.
hinglishExplanation: Anubhavi vyakti; aisa vyakti jise kisi kaam ya kshetra ka lamba aur gahra anubhav ho.
example: A veteran court clerk guided the new recruits through the complex cause list procedures.
keyDistinction: Veteran experienced person hota hai; novice beginner hota hai.

definition: An expert judge in matters of taste and fine arts, such as painting, food, or wine.
hinglishExplanation: Kala, swaad ya soundarya ka visheshagya aur parkhi vyakti.
example: The retired registrar was a connoisseur of ancient Rajasthani miniature paintings.
keyDistinction: Connoisseur refined judgment aur deep taste ka expert hota hai; amateur shaukia hota hai.

definition: An independent person officially appointed to settle a dispute whose decision is legally binding.
hinglishExplanation: Madhyastha; aisa nishpaksh vyakti jo do pakshon ke vivad ka faisla karta hai aur jiska nirnay badhyakari hota hai.
example: The high court appointed a retired judge as the sole arbitrator to resolve the commercial contractual dispute.
keyDistinction: Arbitrator binding verdict (award) sunata hai; mediator sirf aapsi baat-cheet se samjhauta karane mein madad karta hai bina faisla thope.

definition: A person who attempts to make people involved in a conflict come to an agreement; a neutral facilitator.
hinglishExplanation: Samjhauta karane wala vyakti jo dono pakshon ko aapsi baatcheet se hal nikalne mein sahayata karta hai.
example: The family court referred the marital dispute to an experienced mediator to explore reconciliation.
keyDistinction: Mediator faisla nahi deta, sirf baat karwata hai; arbitrator case decide karta hai aur binding order deta hai.

definition: A person who attacks cherished beliefs, established traditions, or traditional institutions.
hinglishExplanation: Paramparao, roodhivadi dharanao ya established idols ko todne aur chunauti dene wala vyakti.
example: Regarded as a radical iconoclast, the young jurist challenged century-old procedural rituals.
keyDistinction: Iconoclast traditions ko challenge karta hai; orthodox unhe bina prashn follow karta hai.

definition: A person who is killed or who suffers greatly because of their religious or other beliefs, or for a cause.
hinglishExplanation: Shaheed; aisa vyakti jo apne vishwas, desh ya siddhant ke liye apne pran tyaag deta hai.
example: The city memorial was erected in honour of martyrs who laid down their lives during the independence movement.
keyDistinction: Martyr cause ke liye jaan deta hai ya severe suffering sehta hai; patriot desh-bhakt hota hai (chahe zinda rahe).

definition: A person who vigorously supports their country and is prepared to defend it against enemies or detractors.
hinglishExplanation: Deshbhakt; apne desh se prem aur uski raksha ke liye tatpar vyakti.
example: Every true patriot respects the constitutional framework and public institutions of the nation.
keyDistinction: Patriot desh se prem aur vafadari rakhta hai; traitor desh se gaddari karta hai.

definition: A person who betrays someone or something, such as a friend, cause, or country.
hinglishExplanation: Gaddar, vishwasghati; jo apne desh, mitr ya sanstha ko dhokha deta hai.
example: The intelligence official who leaked confidential defense blueprints was convicted as a traitor.
keyDistinction: Traitor allegiance aur trust ko todta hai.

definition: An extreme or irrational fear of confined or enclosed spaces.
hinglishExplanation: Band ya tang jagahon (jaise lift, chhota kamra) se hone wala atyadhik darr.
example: Suffering from claustrophobia, the litigant preferred using the staircase rather than the courthouse elevator.
keyDistinction: Claustrophobia = confined spaces ka darr; agoraphobia = aisi jagahon ka darr jahan se escape mushkil lage ya open crowded places.

definition: An extreme or irrational fear of heights.
hinglishExplanation: Unchai se lagne wala aswabhavik darr.
example: Due to severe acrophobia, he could not stand on the terrace of the seven-storey court building.
keyDistinction: Acrophobia unchai (height) ka fear hota hai (acro = summit/high).

definition: An extreme fear of water; also historically used for the symptom of difficulty in swallowing liquids associated with rabies.
hinglishExplanation: Paani se lagne wala darr; rabies rog ka ek pramukh lakshan jisme paani nigalne mein taklif hoti hai.
example: Patients diagnosed with advanced rabies exhibit acute hydrophobia and throat spasms.
keyDistinction: Hydrophobia paani (hydro = water) se sambandhit darr ya medical symptom hai.

definition: Dislike of, contempt for, or prejudice against people from other countries or cultures.
hinglishExplanation: Videshi logon, anjaan sanskritiyo ya aagantuko se darr ya nafrat.
example: The human rights commission warned that political rhetoric was fueling xenophobia against migrant workers.
keyDistinction: Xenophobia foreigners aur unfamiliar people ke against darr/hate hota hai (xeno = stranger).

definition: An obsessive impulse or psychological disorder compelling someone to set things on fire deliberately.
hinglishExplanation: Aag lagane ki apekshakrit manasik aadat ya compulsion; clinical fire-setting disorder.
example: The psychiatric report revealed that the suspect suffered from pyromania rather than criminal greed.
keyDistinction: Pyromania aag lagane ki compulsive bimari hai (pyro = fire); kleptomania chori karne ki.

definition: A recurrent, persistent inability to resist urges to steal items that you generally don't really need.
hinglishExplanation: Bina kisi aarthik zaroorat ke aadat ya manasik rog ke kaaran chori karne ki bimari.
example: The defense submitted psychiatric evidence showing the petty thefts were driven by kleptomania.
keyDistinction: Kleptomania ek clinical impulse control disorder hai (irresistible urge); sadharan theft laalach ya aarthik faayde ke liye hoti hai.

definition: A person who believes that the pursuit of pleasure is the most important thing in life; a pleasure-seeker.
hinglishExplanation: Bhog-vilasi vyakti jo jeevan mein sirf anand aur sukh-suvidhaon ko sabse bada maqsad maanta hai.
example: Uninterested in community service or intellectual pursuits, he lived the carefree life of an unapologetic hedonist.
keyDistinction: Hedonist pleasure-seeker hota hai; ascetic worldly pleasures ko tyaag kar kathor tapashya karta hai.

definition: A person who practices severe self-discipline and abstains from all forms of indulgence, often for religious reasons.
hinglishExplanation: Tapasvi, sanyasi; jo sabhi bhautik sukhon ka tyaag karke sanyam aur saada jeevan jeeta hai.
example: Living in a mountain cave with only a single robe, the ascetic was revered by local villagers.
keyDistinction: Ascetic sukh aur suvidhaon ka tyaag karta hai; hedonist sukh ki talash karta hai.

definition: A system of government by the whole population or all eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.
hinglishExplanation: Loktantra; jantantra jahan shasan janta ke dwara chune huye pratinidhiyon dwara chalaya jata hai.
example: In a robust constitutional democracy, the rule of law reigns supreme over arbitrary decrees.
keyDistinction: Democracy rule by the people (voting) batata hai; republic mein head of state hereditary monarch nahi hota.

definition: A system of government by one person with absolute, unchecked power.
hinglishExplanation: Ek-tantra ya taanashahi; jahan saari shaktiyan sirf ek shasak ke hath mein kendrit hoti hain.
example: Under the dictator's autocracy, judicial courts were stripped of all judicial review powers.
keyDistinction: Autocracy ek vyakti ka shasan hota hai (auto = self/one); oligarchy kuch logon ke chote samooh ka shasan (oligos = few).

definition: A form of government with a monarch (such as a king or queen) at the head, typically hereditary.
hinglishExplanation: Rajtantra; aisi shasan vyavastha jiska mukhiya raja ya rani ho, jo aamtaur par vanshanugat hota hai.
example: The country transitioned from an absolute monarchy to a constitutional parliamentary system.
keyDistinction: Monarchy mein hereditary king/queen hota hai; republic mein elected head hota hai.

definition: A small group of people having control of a country, organization, or institution.
hinglishExplanation: Alptantra; shasan vyavastha jahan kuch prabhavshali logon ke hath mein saari takat hoti hai.
example: Critics argued that the state was run by an economic oligarchy rather than an open parliament.
keyDistinction: Oligarchy koi bhi chota group ho sakta hai (military, party, nobles); plutocracy specifically ameer logon (wealthy) ka shasan hota hai.

definition: A system of government in which priests or religious authorities rule in the name of God or a god.
hinglishExplanation: Dharm-tantra; aisi shasan vyavastha jahan dharmik niyam aur dharm-guru shasan chalate hain.
example: In a strict theocracy, secular laws are subordinate to ancient religious canons.
keyDistinction: Theocracy mein religion govern karta hai (theos = god, kratos = rule); secularism religion aur state authority ko separate rakhta hai.

definition: A system of government or administration in which most important decisions are taken by state officials rather than elected representatives.
hinglishExplanation: Naukarsahi; aisi prashasnik vyavastha jo aupacharik niyamo aur gair-chunindaa sarkari adhikariyon dwara chalti hai.
example: Streamlining court administration is vital to reduce red tape and eliminate bureaucratic delays.
keyDistinction: Bureaucracy administrative system of officials hai, ye sovereign government form nahi balki prashasnik dhancha hai.

definition: A state of disorder due to absence or non-recognition of authority or other controlling systems; absence of government.
hinglishExplanation: Arajakta; sarkar ya kanoon-vyavastha ka poori tarah abhav ya bikhrav.
example: When law enforcement completely collapsed during the invasion, the province descended into total anarchy.
keyDistinction: Anarchy sarkar ka na hona (absence of government) hai; sadharan criminal activity se alag political state of no rule.

definition: Government or governance by the wealthy class; rule by rich individuals.
hinglishExplanation: Dhanik-tantra; ameeron ya dhanwan logon dwara chalayi jane wali shasan vyavastha.
example: When political elections are decided solely by billionaire funding, democracy risks turning into a plutocracy.
keyDistinction: Plutocracy dhan (wealth: ploutos) par aadharit hoti hai; aristocracy birth aur noble lineage par.

definition: An official pardon for people who have been convicted of political or other specified offences.
hinglishExplanation: Sarvajanik kshamadhan; sarkar dwara kisi vishisht varg ya political aropiyon ko di jane wali aupacharik maafi.
example: Following the peace treaty, the governor issued an unconditional general amnesty to all political detainees.
keyDistinction: Amnesty government pardon hota hai (often political group ke liye); acquittal court ka verdict hota hai jo declare karta hai ki dosh sabit nahi hua.

definition: An official government ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country.
hinglishExplanation: Vyaparik pratibandh; kisi desh ke sath vyapar ya aayat-niryat par sarkari rok.
example: The United Nations imposed an arms embargo on the belligerent regime to stop the conflict.
keyDistinction: Embargo sarkar dwara lagaya gaya legal ban hota hai; boycott janta ya consumers dwara voluntary refusal hota hai.

definition: A transparent tank of water or a facility in which live fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.
hinglishExplanation: Jaljeevshala; kanch ka container ya sthan jahan machhliyan aur jaliya jeev rakhe jate hain.
example: The marine biology institute installed a state-of-the-art aquarium for breeding rare coral fish.
keyDistinction: Aquarium = aquatic organisms ka sthan (aqua = water); apiary = madhumakkhiyon ka sthan (apis = bee).

definition: A place where bees are kept, especially a collection of beehives.
hinglishExplanation: Madhumakkhi-paalan kendra; jahan madhumakkhiyon ke chhate rakhe jate hain.
example: The agricultural university established an apiary to promote scientific honey production.
keyDistinction: Apiary = bees (apis = bee); Aviary = birds (avis = bird). Yaad rakhein: 'p' for pollination (bees), 'v' for winged avians (birds).

definition: A large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping birds.
hinglishExplanation: Pakshi-shala; pakshiyon ko rakhne ke liye banaya gaya bada pinjra ya baada.
example: The zoo features a walk-through aviary where exotic parrots fly freely around visitors.
keyDistinction: Aviary birds ke liye hota hai (avis = bird); apiary bees ke liye (apis = bee).

definition: A collection of weapons and military equipment stored by a country, person, or group; or the place where they are kept.
hinglishExplanation: Shastragar; hathiyaron aur sainik saaj-o-samaan ko banane ya store karne ka sthan.
example: Strict security was deployed around the naval arsenal to protect sophisticated defense weaponry.
keyDistinction: Arsenal aamtaur par military-scale manufacture aur large storage ko denote karta hai.

definition: A place where the coins of a country are officially manufactured or struck.
hinglishExplanation: Taksal; jahan sarkari aupacharik sikke dale ya banaye jate hain.
example: The new commemorative twenty-rupee coins were struck at the government mint in Kolkata.
keyDistinction: Mint mein sikke bante hain (coins manufactured); treasury mein sarkar ka paisa store aur manage hota hai.

definition: A stately, magnificent, or large tomb or burial structure.
hinglishExplanation: Makbara; ek vishal aur bhavya imarat jo kisi vishisht vyakti ki samadhi ya qabr par banayi gayi ho.
example: The Taj Mahal is world-renowned as the most magnificent marble mausoleum ever constructed.
keyDistinction: Mausoleum ek building/tomb structure hota hai; cemetery ek burial ground (graveyard) hota hai.

definition: A storehouse or room for threshed grain.
hinglishExplanation: Annagar; anaj ko surakshit store karne ka bhandar-griha.
example: The excavations at Harappa revealed a massive brick granary with raised ventilation ducts.
keyDistinction: Granary specifically anaj (grain) store karne ke liye hoti hai; barn farm animals aur hay ke liye bhi hota hai.

definition: A place of refuge or safety; also a nature reserve where wild animals are protected.
hinglishExplanation: Abhayaranya ya sharan-sthal; aisi surakshit jagah jahan sharan mile ya vanya-jeev surakshit rahein.
example: The migratory cranes found a peaceful sanctuary in the Keoladeo National Park of Bharatpur.
keyDistinction: Sanctuary wildlife ya sacred safety space ko refer karta hai; asylum political protection ya psychiatric care ko.

definition: An account of a person's life written by that person themselves.
hinglishExplanation: Atmakatha; kisi vyakti dwara swayam likhi gayi uske apne jeevan ki kahani.
example: Mahatma Gandhi's 'The Story of My Experiments with Truth' is an acclaimed autobiography.
keyDistinction: Autobiography vyakti khud likhta hai (auto = self, bio = life, graph = write); biography kisi doosre dwara likhi jati hai.

definition: An account of someone's life written by someone else.
hinglishExplanation: Jeevani; kisi vyakti ke jeevan ka vivaran jo kisi doosre lekhak dwara likha gaya ho.
example: The historian authored an authoritative biography of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
keyDistinction: Biography doosra lekhak likhta hai; autobiography subject khud likhta hai.

definition: A list of the books and articles referred to in a scholarly work or relevant to a subject.
hinglishExplanation: Granth-soochi; kisi pustak ya research paper ke aakhir mein di gayi sandarbh kitabon ki list.
example: The research thesis included an exhaustive bibliography of Supreme Court and High Court precedents.
keyDistinction: Bibliography kitabon ki list/references hoti hai; anthology chuni hui rachnaon ka sangrah (collection of works) hota hai.

definition: A published collection of poems or other pieces of writing by various authors or on a single theme.
hinglishExplanation: Kavya-sangrah ya sahityik sankalan; alag-alag lekhakon ki rachnaon ka ek saath sangrah.
example: The professor compiled an anthology of twentieth-century Indian English poetry for the syllabus.
keyDistinction: Anthology khud literary texts ka collection hai; bibliography sirf kitabon ke naamon ki list hai.

definition: A book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed; an author's unpublished text.
hinglishExplanation: Pandulipi; hath se likha gaya dastawez ya kisi pustak ki mool hastlikhit prati.
example: The archival wing preserves an ancient manuscript of the Rajasthani epic written on palm leaves.
keyDistinction: Manuscript hath se likha mool dastawez hota hai (manu = hand, script = write); transcript kisi spoken conversation ka official written record hota hai.

definition: A phrase or statement written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone.
hinglishExplanation: Samadhi-lekh; kisi mrit vyakti ki qabr ya samadhi ke patthar par khoda gaya smriti lekh.
example: The tombstone bore a poignant epitaph: 'A fearless defender of the oppressed.'
keyDistinction: Epitaph tombstone par inscribed short writing hoti hai; eulogy marne ke baad bola ya likha gaya lamba prashansa bhashan hota hai; elegy shok-geet (mourning poem) hota hai.

definition: A speech or piece of writing that praises someone or something highly, typically someone who has just died.
hinglishExplanation: Prashamsa-bhashan; kisi vyakti (vishishtarup se nidhan ke baad) ke samman mein di gayi stuti ya tarif.
example: The bar council president delivered a moving eulogy praising the late advocate's integrity.
keyDistinction: Eulogy speech/writing of high praise (stuti) hota hai; elegy dukh aur shok vyakt karne wali poem (shok-kavita) hoti hai.

definition: A poem of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead.
hinglishExplanation: Shok-kavita ya marthiya; kisi ke nidhan par dukh vyakt karne wali kavita.
example: Thomas Gray's 'Elegy Written in a Country Churchyard' is a classic masterpiece of English literature.
keyDistinction: Elegy kavita (poem of mourning) hoti hai; eulogy prashansa bhashan (speech of praise) hota hai.

definition: The practice of taking someone else's work or ideas and passing them off as one's own without attribution.
hinglishExplanation: Sahityik chori; kisi doosre ke vicharon, lekh ya shabdon ko apna bata kar bina credit diye prayog karna.
example: The university cancelled the scholar's doctorate after detecting wholesale plagiarism from foreign journals.
keyDistinction: Plagiarism dishonest copying hoti hai (stealing without citation); parody hasya ke liye ki gayi deliberate comic imitation hoti hai.

definition: A fictitious name, especially one used by an author to conceal their real identity; a pen name.
hinglishExplanation: Upanam ya chhadm-naam; lekhak dwara apni asli pehchan chhupane ke liye apnaya gaya kalpanik naam.
example: Munshi Premchand was the famous pseudonym of the celebrated Hindi novelist Dhanpat Rai Srivastava.
keyDistinction: Pseudonym ek assume kiya hua fake naam hota hai (pen name); anonymous mein koi naam hi nahi hota (nameless/unknown).

definition: Occurring once every year; yearly.
hinglishExplanation: Varshik; saal mein ek baar hone wala.
example: The registry published its annual statistics report detailing all cases disposed during the year.
keyDistinction: Annual = once a year (saal mein 1 baar); biannual = twice a year (saal mein 2 baar); biennial = every two years (2 saal mein 1 baar).

definition: Occurring twice a year; semiannual.
hinglishExplanation: Varsh mein do baar hone wala (ardh-varshik).
example: The judicial academy conducts biannual orientation workshops for newly appointed civil judges.
keyDistinction: Biannual = 1 saal mein 2 baar; Biennial = 2 saal mein 1 baar. Is trap ko competitive exams mein bar-bar pucha jata hai.

definition: Taking place every two years, or lasting for two years.
hinglishExplanation: Do varsh mein ek baar aayojit hone wala (dwivarshik).
example: The international judicial conference is a biennial gathering held every alternate year.
keyDistinction: Biennial = every two years (2 saal mein ek baar); Biannual = twice in a single year.

definition: A person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.
hinglishExplanation: Samkaleen; ek hi samay ya kaal mein astitva mein rehne wala vyakti ya cheez.
example: Akbar and Queen Elizabeth I were contemporaries who ruled in the late sixteenth century.
keyDistinction: Contemporary samkaleen hota hai (same era); temporary alpkaalin hota hai (short duration).

definition: Lasting for a very short time; fleeting or transitory.
hinglishExplanation: Kshanbhangur; behad kam samay tak tikne wala.
example: Internet social media fame is often ephemeral, fading within a matter of days.
keyDistinction: Ephemeral short-lived hota hai; perpetual lagatar anant kaal tak chalne wala (continuous) hota hai.

definition: A person who held a job or office before the current holder, or a thing that came before another.
hinglishExplanation: Purvavarti; kisi pad ya sthan par vartaman vyakti se theek pehle rehne wala vyakti.
example: The newly appointed registrar praised his predecessor for digitizing the court records.
keyDistinction: Predecessor pehle aane wala (came before) hota hai; successor baad mein aane wala (comes after) hota hai.

definition: A person or thing that succeeds another; someone who takes over an office or position after another person.
hinglishExplanation: Uttaradhikari ya parvarti; jo kisi pad par baad mein aata hai.
example: The chief justice nominated his senior-most colleague as his prospective successor.
keyDistinction: Successor baad mein aane wala hota hai; predecessor pehle aane wala.

definition: Certain to happen; unavoidable.
hinglishExplanation: Avashyambhawi; jiska hona nishchit ho aur jise tala na ja sake.
example: With conclusive video evidence against the defendant, conviction was virtually inevitable.
keyDistinction: Inevitable = tala nahi ja sakta (unavoidable event); infallible = jo kabhi galti na kare (incapable of error).

definition: Incapable of making mistakes or being wrong; completely trustworthy.
hinglishExplanation: Achook; jo kabhi galti na kare ya jisme truti ki sambhavna na ho.
example: Even the most experienced forensic fingerprint analyst is not entirely infallible.
keyDistinction: Infallible galti na karne wala (never wrong) hota hai; inevitable unavoidable event hota hai.

definition: Not clear enough to be read; impossible or very difficult to decipher.
hinglishExplanation: Apathaniya; aisi handwriting ya text jise padhna asambhav ya behad mushkil ho.
example: The high court directed the doctor to submit a typed report because the handwritten prescription was completely illegible.
keyDistinction: Illegible = padha nahi ja sakta (unreadable); eligible = yogyata rakhne wala (qualified). Phonetic trap!

definition: About to happen; impending or very near at hand.
hinglishExplanation: Asanna; jo bohot jald ya turant ghatit hone wala ho.
example: The advocate hurried into the courtroom because the pronouncement of the final verdict was imminent.
keyDistinction: Imminent = about to happen soon; Immanent = existing within, omnipresent/inherent (antarvyapi); Eminent = prasiddh/distinguished.

definition: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.
hinglishExplanation: Apravasi; aisa vyakti jo kisi doosre desh se aakar naye desh mein bas jata hai.
example: The citizenship amendment established strict verification procedures for every new immigrant.
keyDistinction: Immigrant = In-coming (doosre desh se andar aane wala: I for In); Emigrant = Exit (apna desh chhod kar bahar jaane wala: E for Exit).

definition: A person who leaves their own country in order to settle permanently in another.
hinglishExplanation: Utpravasi; aisa vyakti jo apna desh chhod kar kisi doosre desh mein rehne chala jata hai.
example: Many young software engineers from India became emigrants settling permanently in Canada.
keyDistinction: Emigrant country chhodta hai (Exits); immigrant naye country mein aata hai (Enters).

definition: No longer produced or used; out of date because a newer alternative has replaced it.
hinglishExplanation: Aprachalit; aisi cheez ya niyam jo ab chalan mein nahi hai kyunki uski jagah naye vikalp aa chuke hain.
example: Typewriters became largely obsolete in high court offices after the introduction of digital computers.
keyDistinction: Obsolete tech/practices replace hone se outdated ho jati hain; extinct species ya living beings poori tarah vilupt ho jate hain.

definition: Make something bad less severe, serious, or painful; to alleviate.
hinglishExplanation: Kam karna, tivrata ghatana; kisi sankat ya saza ke prabhav ko kam karna.
example: The defense advocate pleaded that the accused's clean record should mitigate the severity of the sentence.
keyDistinction: Mitigate sthiti ko less severe karta hai; exacerbate/aggravate sthiti ko aur badtar (worse) bana deta hai.

definition: Make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.
hinglishExplanation: Badtar karna, bigadna; kisi samasya ya dukh ko aur zyada teevra kar dena.
example: Refusing to comply with court summons will only exacerbate your legal troubles.
keyDistinction: Exacerbate problem ko make worse karta hai; mitigate alleviate karta hai.

definition: Free someone from a criminal charge by a formal verdict of not guilty in a court of law.
hinglishExplanation: Bari karna, doshmukt karna; adalat dwara kisi aaropi ko aupacharik roop se nirdosh declare karna.
example: Due to a complete lack of corroborating evidence, the sessions judge had to acquit the accused.
keyDistinction: Acquit criminal charges se doshmukt karta hai (not guilty); convict apradhi thehrata hai (guilty).

definition: Subject someone to hostility and ill-treatment, especially because of their race, political or religious beliefs.
hinglishExplanation: Utpeedan karna, satana; kisi vyakti ya varg ko uski jati ya vishwas ke kaaran bar-bar pareshan karna.
example: Historically, tyrannical rulers persecuted minority religious groups through discriminatory laws.
keyDistinction: Persecute satana/harass karna hota hai (hostile ill-treatment); prosecute adalat mein kanooni mukadma chalana hota hai (legal court action).

definition: Institute or conduct legal proceedings against someone in respect of a criminal charge.
hinglishExplanation: Kanooni karyawahi karna; adalat mein kisi par abhiyog chalana.
example: The public prosecutor decided to prosecute the fraudulent contractor under the Prevention of Corruption Act.
keyDistinction: Prosecute lawful legal court action chalana hai; persecute unlawful zulm aur satana hai.

definition: Renounce one's throne or formally give up a monarchical position or supreme responsibility.
hinglishExplanation: Rajgaddi tyaagna; aupacharik roop se singhasan ya shasan ka pad chhodna.
example: Facing immense political unrest, the aging king decided to abdicate in favour of the crown prince.
keyDistinction: Abdicate specifically throne ya sovereign high office chhodne ke liye lagta hai; renounce kisi bhi claim, belief ya right ko chhodne ke liye aamtaur par lagta hai.

definition: An animal that typically has and moves on four feet.
hinglishExplanation: Chaupaya; chaar pairo wala janwar.
example: Horses, cattle, and deer are all classified zoologically as quadrupeds.
keyDistinction: Quadruped = four-footed (quad = 4, ped = foot); biped = two-footed (bi = 2, ped = foot).

definition: An animal or person that eats food of both plant and animal origin.
hinglishExplanation: Sarvahari; aisa jeev jo paudhe aur maans dono khata ho.
example: Humans and bears are omnivores capable of digesting both vegetation and meat.
keyDistinction: Omnivore = both plants and meat; herbivore = only plants; carnivore = only meat.
